name: Weesa Swamp Rider (CR 1/2)
body:
WEESA SWAMP RIDER
CR 1/2

This tall, saurian humanoid has smooth greenish-brown skin. Its head features a ducklike bill, two eyes set on short stalks, and very long earlike flaps that fold back and trail down the creature’s back.

XP 200
Weesa cavalierAPG 1
LN Medium humanoid (weesa)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +2 armor, +2 shield)
hp 13 (1d10+2+1)
Fort +4, Ref +2, Will +0

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee lance +3 (1d8+3/×3 P; reach, double damage from the back of a charging mount) or heavy mace +3 (1d8+3 B; crush, shove)
Ranged shortbow +3 (1d6/x3, range incr. 60 ft.)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with lance)
Special Attacks challengeAPG (1/day), lucky shot (1/day)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 6, Wis 10, Cha 15
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Mounted Combat, Precise Strike
Skills Knowledge (local) +2, Ride +4, Swim +8
Languages Common, Weesa
SQ amphibious, mount, Order (Order of the Shield), tactician (1/day), weapon familiarity
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, heavy wooden shield, lance, heavy mace, other gear)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Lucky Shot (Ex)

Once per day, when a weesa swamp rider misses a target with a melee or ranged attack, they can roll again to see if the attack instead hits a target adjacent to their intended target, using the new target’s AC. A weesa cannot use this ability if they rolled a natural 1 on the original attack roll.

MOUNT

Swamp strider; N Large animal; Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +7; Aura algal gas (30 ft., Fort DC 13); AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 11; hp 13 (2 HD); Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +1; Weakness flammable; Speed 50 ft., swim 30 ft.; Melee gore +3 (1d6+3); Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.; CMB +4; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip); Feats Run; SQ link, tricks (4)

ABOUT

Weesa swamp riders patrol the expansive wetlands and marshes of their homeworld, mounted atop trained swamp striders. Agile in the water and capable of devastating charges on land, they defend their secluded communities from predators and invaders alike.

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
